greeting.text: Hahaha! Look at that, a fresh face! Jack the Ripper, Green Mantis. Don't worry, I only cut things that cut back.
A delver! Good. Delvers always have something worth cutting.
Commoner? Noble? Doesn't matter. Can you swing something sharp? That's all I want to know.
So YOU'RE the one filling the guardians' graves! Come here, let me shake your hand. Carefully.
Hey, it's you! Got anything for me to cut?
Still alive? Hahaha! I like that.

hint.text: Everything has a seam. Armour, magic, even the dark between two rooms. Find it and I'll teach you the cut.
Barrier in your way? Cut it. Door in your way? Cut it. Rule in your way... I'll cut that too, if nobody's looking.
Safe Zones are for resting, and resting is for people with somewhere to be. I'm going to sharpen.
Don't mind me licking the blade. It helps me think. It also tastes of victory. Hahaha!
That lazy Black Bull captain keeps calling me a madman. Pot, kettle! Hahaha!
I was born a commoner and I cut just fine. Blood doesn't matter; the edge does. Remember that.
No guardians dead yet? Then you're missing the best part. Go! Hear them crack!
The Eye of the Midnight Sun are lovely targets. Lots of tricks, lots of seams. Tell me how it goes!
Heath Grice? He never liked being cut. Don't blame him. Hahaha!
Gravity, huh? Cut the field itself if you've got the reach. Otherwise... run! Hahaha!
Lucius reads attacks before they land? Then cut fast. Four cuts inside a second, and see how he reads that!
Other worlds, other swords! I hope somebody out there cuts better than I do. Then I can stop being bored.

farewell.text: Hahaha! Go bring me stories with blood in them!
Don't get cut! ...Unless it makes a good story.
